name: canonkeeper
description: Turns a SillyTavern roleplay chat into a correct, self-maintaining World Info lorebook.

scripts.build:story: node bin/canonkeeper.js build fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --out .run/story --replay fixtures/story/recorded/replies.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js pin .run/story 'Brother Saul' && node bin/canonkeeper.js pin .run/story 'The Undercroft' && node bin/canonkeeper.js rerun fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --run .run/story && node bin/canonkeeper.js update fixtures/story/edits/undercroft/transcript.jsonl --run .run/story --out .run/story/edits/undercroft --replay fixtures/story/edits/undercroft/replies.json && node harness/gate.js --story fixtures/story --run .run/story --edits
scripts.build:live: node harness/live-sim.js fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --out .run/live --replay fixtures/story/live && node harness/gate.js --story fixtures/story --run .run/live --live
scripts.build:chunked: node bin/canonkeeper.js build fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --out .run/chunked --context 15200 --output-share 0.5 --replay fixtures/story/chunked/replies.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js pin .run/chunked 'Brother Saul' && node bin/canonkeeper.js rerun fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --run .run/chunked --context 15200 --output-share 0.5 && node harness/gate.js --story fixtures/story --run .run/chunked --chunked
scripts.build:audit: node harness/plant.js replies fixtures/story/recorded/replies.json fixtures/story/audit/plant.json .run/audit/planted-build-replies.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js build fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --out .run/audit/clean --replay fixtures/story/recorded/replies.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js audit fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --run .run/audit/clean --replay fixtures/story/audit/verify-clean.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js build fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --out .run/audit/planted --replay .run/audit/planted-build-replies.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js pin .run/audit/planted 'Brother Saul' && node harness/plant.js book .run/audit/planted fixtures/story/audit/plant.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js audit fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --run .run/audit/planted --replay fixtures/story/audit/verify-planted.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js rerun fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --run .run/audit/planted && node harness/gate.js --story fixtures/story --run .run/audit --audit
scripts.build:deep: node bin/canonkeeper.js build fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --out .run/deep --replay fixtures/story/deep/replies.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js pin .run/deep 'Brother Saul' && node bin/canonkeeper.js rerun fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --run .run/deep && node harness/gate.js --story fixtures/story --run .run/deep --deep
